text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka hasn't come to today's training session. I decide to go search for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The long and agitated groan I hear is coming from Silence Suzuka. I find her distressed, pacing around in counterclockwise circles.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just how am I going to manage?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I have an English test tomorrow. I've been warned about my poor grades recently…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So, I was wondering if there was a way to study for the test while I run…
choice_data_list: You know training's already started, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks genuinely surprised. I tell her to prioritize her studies today.
